satellites.title: Mountain in the Trigrams
satellites.evidence: The 說卦 commentary associates 艮 with mountain. Its meaning is traditional and contextual, not an etymology of 山.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: From the Mountain, the State Looks Small
satellites.evidence: Mencius 7A24: 孔子登東山而小魯 — Confucius climbed the eastern hill and Lu looked small; climbing Mount Tai, the whole world looked small. What one has seen of the sea makes other waters hard to call water.
satellites.caveat: The check covers the first clause; the rest is paraphrase of the same passage.
